info.title: PageTurner web novel and translation workflow
info.description: Canonical wire contracts for shared source discovery, immutable chapter import and server-owned translation jobs. Source DTOs match NovelSourceService; workflow DTOs match WorkflowModels. Saved translation retrieval and CSRF bootstrap are defined in translation-v1.openapi.json.

servers.description: Loopback development; use HTTPS for deployment.

post.description: Authenticated CSRF-protected check of one fixed short English sample using the shared translation runtime. The default source language is auto. No chapter, job, checkpoint, translated text or credential is saved. Paid providers may charge for this sample. At most one live worker per account and four globally; starts for an account are separated by ten seconds. Cooldown tracking is limited to 512 accounts. A 20-second deadline returns a FAILED timeout and cancels the worker, whose slot remains reserved until cleanup completes. Explicit cancellation of the controller future reaches the worker; HTTP disconnect detection depends on the servlet container, so a disconnected check may continue until its deadline. Every response is non-cacheable.

post.description: Create or reuse a translation execution. Repeated matching idempotency requests reuse a job; different settings under the same key return 409. At most four active jobs per user. Custom API keys are memory-only and must be supplied again after interruption. Reuse settings from the failed job with retryOf to copy valid checkpoints.

sourceLanguage.description: auto is recommended because the check uses a fixed English sample; it does not change the reader's source-language setting.

apiKey.description: Optional transient override of the configured server key. CR/LF are forbidden.

endpoint.description: LLM endpoint only; must match the existing server allowlist exactly after trailing-slash normalization.

message.description: A fixed safe Korean message chosen from the public code; never raw provider details.

model.description: Resolved model identity from the shared translation runtime, which may be non-empty even for a provider without a configurable model.

NovelCatalog.description: A provider-owned, one-based catalog page. Unknown totals are null. UI pagination within this result is separate from fetching another provider page.

SourceParagraph.description: Stable source paragraph identity and original text. Ordinals preserve source order independently of rendered pages.

StoredChapter.description: Immutable imported chapter revision belonging to the authenticated user. Paragraphs are returned only for import and detail.

bookUrl.description: Original source URL; empty for an uploaded local document.

chapterUrl.description: Original source URL; empty for an uploaded local document.

ChapterSummary.description: Imported chapter metadata without paragraph bodies. Fetch /chapters/{recordId} before reading.

bookUrl.description: Original source URL; empty for an uploaded local document.

chapterUrl.description: Original source URL; empty for an uploaded local document.

url.description: Readable chapter URL, fetched on the server through the source provider.

bookUrl.description: Optional matching book detail URL. The source chapter must belong to this book.

GlossaryEntry.description: Defaults preserve the original source/target contract. Kind and display aliases affect only reader display, while enabled and caseSensitive also affect the shared translation fingerprint. Display options never rewrite a stored translation artifact.

TranslationJobSettings.description: The normalized settings used for this job, without credentials. Reuse these values with providerKind and retryOf to resume committed paragraphs.

targetLanguage.description: Target language must differ from source and must not be auto.

sourceLanguage.description: Defaults to the imported chapter language.

endpoint.description: LLM endpoint; must be allowed by server configuration. Never fetched by the browser.

apiKey.description: Memory-only credential for this execution. Must never be logged or written to job records, offline storage, URLs or response bodies.

glossary.description: Source terms must be unique after case folding and trimming.

retryOf.description: Retry a FAILED, CANCELLED or INTERRUPTED job with the same chapter revision and normalized settings. The server copies committed paragraph checkpoints.

TranslationJob.description: Server-owned execution. COMPLETED references a full immutable saved translation; partial translations are not published. Cancellation preserves imported source and committed checkpoints. Expired workers become INTERRUPTED.

WorkflowProblem.description: RFC 9457 problem response. Display safe messages; never echo provider exception details or credentials.

UploadedChapterRequest.description: Uploads extracted local document text only. Binary file assets are never accepted. Total paragraph text must not exceed 1,000,000 UTF-16 code units.
